reading.text:
Reading of def Spec.BrownianAssumption25 (Assumption 2.5 in the Brownian reduction; possibly with
Assumption 2.4 bundled).

Paper notion. With G in R^{m x n} (full rank by Assumption 2.4) and constants alpha, beta_1, beta_2:
(a) terminal: for all X_T, X'_T in L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n),
   E <delta g_T, G delta X_T> >= alpha E |G delta X_T|^2;
(b) interior: for a.e. t in [0,T] and all diagonal inputs (Theta,mu),(Theta',mu') in D_t (Brownian,
   H_B = R^n x R^m x R^{m x d}),
   E[<delta b, G^T delta Y> + <delta sigma, G^T delta Z>_F + <-delta f, G delta X>]
     <= -beta_1 E[|G^T delta Y|^2 + |G^T delta Z|_F^2] - beta_2 E|G delta X|^2;
(c) constants: alpha, beta_1, beta_2 >= 0, alpha + beta_1 > 0, beta_1 + beta_2 > 0, beta_1 > 0 if
   m < n, alpha, beta_2 > 0 if m > n.
A faithful Lean definition: all three parts, the jump term deleted (not just set to zero with a
U-coordinate present), Frobenius pairing for sigma/Z, G^T acting on Y in R^m giving R^n and on Z
giving R^{n x d}. Expectations: Bochner integrals are fine when the integrands are integrable
(they are under Assumption 2.3 and L^2 inputs); a junk 0 for non-integrable integrands only makes
the condition stronger at such inputs (should be noted). If G full rank is bundled, it must be
rank = min(m,n).

comparison.text:
Comparison, Spec.BrownianAssumption25 (BrownianForms.lean:133-144).

- Terminal: for all X_T, X'_T strongly F_T-measurable in L^2: the pairing <dg_T, G dX_T> is
  integrable and E<dg_T, G dX_T> >= alpha E|G dX_T|^2. OK (integrability made explicit - the paper's
  expectation presupposes it; under (2.6) and L^2 inputs it holds).
- Interior: a.e. t in [0,T], BrownianMonoAt: E[<db, G^T dY> + <dsigma, G^T dZ>_F + <-df, G dX>]
  <= -beta_1 E[|G^T dY|^2 + |G^T dZ|_F^2] - beta_2 E|G dX|^2 with integrability of the pairing;
  jump pairing and ||G^T dU||^2 deleted. GX G^T : R^m -> R^n, GZ G^T = (G^T (x) I_d) : R^{m x d} ->
  R^{n x d} (matrix product G^T Z), GX G : R^n -> R^m. OK.
- Constants n m alpha beta_1 beta_2: alpha, beta_1, beta_2 >= 0, alpha+beta_1 > 0,
  beta_1+beta_2 > 0, m < n -> beta_1 > 0, n < m -> alpha, beta_2 > 0. OK.
- G full rank not bundled (as in the main Assumption25; rank stated separately at use sites).
Verdict: faithful with representation choices.

verdict.detail:
Representation choices: integrability of the terminal and interior pairings is required explicitly
(the paper's expectations presuppose it; it holds under Assumption 2.3 for L^2 inputs); the tuple
space is TupleH at nu = 0 with the jump terms deleted; G full rank (Assumption 2.4) is stated
separately at use sites; the filtration is a parameter.
